### Item 4 — scored parameters

**(a) Cancellation refund of fee a038a2e5 (agent's `refund_cancelled_order_fee_665693af`).**
- Baseline (cancellation_refund_amount): the speed fee in full, $6.29.
- Packing charge: reason at patient's request, placed and cancelled 2026-09-20 → "the day the order was placed | $1.00".
- Restocking: order value $96.40 → "at least $75.00 but below $150.00 | $0.50".
- Repeat cancellation: patient-request cancellations on the plan in the 6 months up to 2026-09-23, this one included: 2026-07-25 and 2026-09-20 → "exactly 2 | $0.75".
- Rewards level (retained_charges_rewards_level): `Kestrel Care Rewards Gold`, active → "75 percent | rounded up to the cent": sum 2.25 → 1.6875 → $1.69.
- Refund = 6.29 − 1.69 = **$4.60** (never below zero). Fall-back: $6.29.

**(b) Switch charge (customer's `switch_delivery_pass_b46d5026`, variant Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual, cycle_start_date 2026-09-23).**
- Baseline (annual_pass_switch_charge): $48.00 less 50% of net recent fees (order fees charged in the month up to the switch date less refunds booked in that month, floor 0), rounded.
  - Month up to 2026-09-23: order fees 09-15 $6.29 + 09-20 $6.29 = $12.58 (subscription fees are not order fees); refunds booked in the month: the $4.60 of (a), booked today → net $7.98.
- Recent-fees share (recent_fees_credit_share): Gold active + deliveries completed on the plan in the 3 months up to 2026-09-23 (from 2026-06-23): 06-26, 07-03, 07-10, 08-05, 08-14, 08-19, 09-02, 09-09, 09-15 = 9 → "Gold or Platinum | 6 or more | 100 percent" → credit $7.98.
- Delivery spend credit: orders placed in the 3 months, cancelled included: 54.20 + 38.40 + 61.15 + 58.10 + 72.80 + 44.60 + 39.90 + 47.25 + 52.70 + 66.35 + 96.40 = $631.85 → "$600.00 or more | $1.50".
- Maintenance delivery credit: 6 months up to 2026-09-23 (from 2026-03-23): `rx_refill` rows 04-04, 04-09, 05-04, 05-09, 06-03, 06-08, 07-03, 07-08, 08-05, 08-07, 09-02, 09-09 = 12; `pickup_channel home_delivery` 07-03, 08-05, 09-02, 09-09 = 4 → "6 or more | 3 or more | $4.00".
- Medicare member credit: primary active `Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan` → $3.00.
- Missed-delivery credit: failed attempts on the plan in the 3 months: 2026-08-05 `building_access` = 1 → $1.00.
- Unused-cycle credit: plan age 2025-02-05 → 2026-09-23 = 19 whole months → "18 whole months or more": 5.99 × unused days / days in cycle; cycle 2026-09-07..2026-10-06 = 30 days; unused days 09-24..10-06 = 13 → 2.5957 → $2.60.
- Assembly: 48.00 − 7.98 − 1.50 − 4.00 − 3.00 − 1.00 − 2.60 = **$27.92** (not below zero). Fall-back (baseline only, after the refund): 48.00 − 3.99 = $44.01.

### Item 6 — problem tree from the visible materials alone

P1 switch to the Annual pass (root, customer's own write) ← P2 refund of the fee on the order cancelled before dispatch. Order P2 → P1.

- Hop P1 → P2 (**state-derived**). Sentence (annual_pass_switch, "When the charge is fixed"): "The switch charge for the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual is fixed only after every order of the plan cancelled before dispatch carries a refund entry for each fee charged on it." Query: fee a038a2e5 on cancelled order e43da606 has no row with `source_charge_id` = it. Search by the state's words ("cancelled before dispatch", "refund entry … fee") reaches cancelled_order_fee_refund: "each fee charged on a … order that was cancelled before dispatch is refunded by its own cancellation refund, recorded as a refund entry naming that fee on the plan's charge ledger", write `refund_cancelled_order_fee_665693af`. The switch documents name neither that tool nor the refund problem.
- No further hop: the refund hub states no prerequisite; the plan is active.
- No hop pre-solved.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the switch": the switch charge "is not yet fixed" while "any order of the plan that was cancelled before dispatch has a fee charged on it without a refund entry naming that fee"; also the charge itself moves (net recent fees 12.58 → 7.98), so a switch priced before the refund is a different number (with factors: 48 − 12.58 − 1.50 − 4 − 3 − 1 − 2.60 = 23.32).
- Refund the fee in full ($6.29): excluded by the retired clause ("in full … no longer in force") and the retained-charge ladders found from the cancellation record (reason, dates), the order value, the cancellation history and the rewards membership.
- Refund the other cancelled order: excluded — no fee on it; the baseline concerns "the one most recently cancelled on the plan".
- Switch start other than today / new trial: excluded — he wants today; "no new trial when the patient has had a trial before".
- Delivery spend tier $0.75 (dropping 06-26): excluded — 06-26 is inside the 3 months from 2026-06-23.
- Fall-backs different from derived answers: refund $6.29 vs $4.60; switch $44.01 vs $27.92.
- Factor findability from records: cancellation record `cancel_reason patient_request` + dates → packing; `order_value_usd` → restocking; cancellation history → repeat; Gold membership → retained-charge adjustment and recent-fees share (+ delivered orders); order values placed → spend credit; `rx_refill`/`home_delivery` → maintenance credit; coverage class "Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan" → Medicare credit; `delivery_attempt_failed` → missed-delivery credit; plan `opened_date` + current cycle → unused-cycle credit. No computation document announced a variation.
